title: 第七章 成为宫奴第八章 南梁三公主
slug: 根骨被毁我逆袭成准帝
lines: 他们一走进殿门就拱手行礼，齐齐道：“参见陛下！”
仲太傅见他们行礼时状态随意散漫，气得准备再谏，刚踏出一步，就被昭武帝一个眼神扫回来，他硬生生顿在了原地，捋着胡须闭了嘴。
“诸位妖王，你们来我大昭三年，战功赫赫，朕今日要论功行赏。”
“拿笔来！”
昭武帝清喝一声，候在一旁的内侍急忙将明黄布帛和笔墨端了上来。昭武帝大手一挥，在布帛上快速书写，末了，盖上玉玺。
做完这一切，他抬了抬手，内侍恭恭敬敬地将明黄圣旨捧起来，展开，朗声道：“奉天承运皇帝，诏曰：念大荒群妖归心、戍守北塞有功，特颁金册玉旨，册封十二妖王。划北塞千里寒荒之地，归山君、啸天、裂风、白猿王、守山五王辖治，镇守北塞险关。划南沼万里瘴泽之地，尽归窃耳、夜冥、毒尾、络天、蚀骨、吞江豕、覆波鱼七王统辖，稳固大荒南部妖族。十二妖王各守封土，共护边境，世代承袭王爵，永享疆土俸禄，违旨者，削爵除封。”
圣旨读完，十二妖王脸上都露出喜色，他们齐齐拱手行礼，声音如天雷滚落。
“谢陛下隆恩！”
仲太傅站在文臣班中，嘴唇动了动，看向太子萧世安，见他只是垂着眼立着，没有再开口的意思，终究还是没再说话，只低眉垂目，叹了口气，退回到班列里。
庄拓紧绷的肩背终于松下来，颈间伤口扯得疼，却忍不住弯了嘴角，抬手按着伤口，血又渗出来，却笑得得意。
虽然陛下听了太子的话，没有完全按照他奏折里的意思给十二妖王封赏，但是结果也不错。其余，可徐徐图之。
昭武帝看着阶下昂首而立的十二妖王，郑重道：“朕在此承诺，凡是守大昭者，皆是大昭子民，不论出身人族还是妖族，有功必赏，有罪必罚。今日赏了你们的功，日后若有半分异心，朕的破穹弓，也绝不饶人。”
“臣等不敢！”十二妖王再次拱手，声震殿瓦。
早朝上发生的事不到半个时辰就传遍整个皇宫，孟婵玥却对此一无所知。
此时她正和十来个宫奴一起蹲在一口水井边洗衣服，在她身旁堆了高高的一堆衣物。
黍管事双手背在身后，哼着曲子走来走去监工，看到有宫奴偷懒，立马斜眼瞪过去。候在一旁的宫侍见了，上前半步就是一鞭。
时值寒冬，井水冰冷刺骨，孟婵玥的手一伸进水里就冻红了。身为南梁三公主，她从小锦衣玉食，何时做过这种粗活。那纤细白嫩的手揉过粗麻衣物，转瞬间，几道红痕就出现在手背上。
黍管事看到她这副模样，顿时起了怜香惜玉的心思。他走过去，凑到孟婵玥身旁。
“婵玥，你做宫奴可惜了。”
“以你的相貌，只要你愿意，有的是男人为你鞍前马后。”
说完，一双细长的眉眼直勾勾地盯着孟婵玥雪白细腻的脖颈。
孟婵玥被他油腻猥琐的目光盯着，只觉得胃里翻江倒海。她目光转冷，大力揉搓木盆里的衣物，冰冷刺骨的井水溢出来，溅湿了黍管事的黑靴。
迎上孟婵玥凛然冷冽的眼神，黍管事不由惊地后退半步，随后恼羞成怒地站起来，大声道：“宫奴婵玥对本管事不敬，加一倍份额，洗不完不准吃饭。”
话音落下，孟婵玥面前又多了一堆衣物，比先前的还要高上些许。
content_en:
As soon as they walked into the palace gate, they bowed their hands and said in unison: "See you, Your Majesty!"
Seeing that they were casually saluting, Grand Tutor Zhong was so angry that he was about to remonstrate again. As soon as he took a step, Emperor Zhaowu glanced back at him, and he stopped abruptly, stroking his beard and shut up.
"Dear demon kings, you came to me in the third year of the Great Zhao Dynasty and made great achievements in battle. Today I will reward you based on your merits."
"Bring me a pen!"
Emperor Zhaowu gave a clear shout, and the waiting chamberlain hurriedly brought up the bright yellow cloth and pen and ink. Emperor Zhaowu waved his hand, quickly wrote on the cloth, and finally stamped it with a jade seal.
After doing all this, he raised his hand, and the chamberlain respectfully held up the bright yellow imperial edict, unfolded it, and said loudly: "The emperor is entrusted by heaven, and the edict says: The demons of the great wilderness have returned to their hearts, and they have made great contributions in guarding the North Fortress. I will issue a golden book and jade edict and canonize the twelve demon kings. The land of thousands of miles of cold wasteland in the North Fortress will be returned to Shanjun, Xiaotian, Liifeng, White Ape King, The five kings guarding the mountain and guarding the dangerous passes of the southern swamp are all under the jurisdiction of the seven kings Tie Er, Ye Ming, Poisonous Tail, Luo Tian, Xianggu, Swallowing Swallowing and Fuboyu, and stabilize the demon clan in the southern part of the wilderness. The twelve demon kings each guard the territory and jointly protect the border. They inherit the royal title from generation to generation and enjoy the territory and salary forever. Those who violate the order will be stripped of their title. "
After reading the imperial edict, the faces of the twelve demon kings showed joy. They all bowed their hands and bowed, their voices rolling down like thunder from the sky.
"Thank you, Your Majesty, for your kindness!"
Standing in the class of civil servants, Taifu Zhong moved his lips and looked at the prince Xiao Shi'an. He saw that he just stood with his eyes lowered and had no intention of speaking again. After all, he did not speak anymore. He just lowered his eyebrows and lowered his eyes, sighed, and returned to the class train.
Zhuang Tuo's tense shoulders and back finally relaxed. The wound on his neck hurt, but he couldn't help but curl his mouth and raised his hand to press the wound. Blood seeped out again, but he smiled proudly.
Although His Majesty listened to the prince's words and did not fully follow the instructions in his memorial to reward the twelve demon kings, the result was not bad. The rest can be figured out slowly.
Emperor Zhaowu looked at the twelve demon kings standing at the foot of the stairs, and solemnly said: "I hereby promise that all those who guard the Jokhang are the people of Jokhang, regardless of whether they are from the human race or the demon race. Those who have merit will be rewarded, and those who are guilty will be punished. I have rewarded you for your merits today, but if you have even the slightest intention to disobey me in the future, I will never spare you my Sky-Breaking Bow."
"I don't dare!" The Twelve Demon Kings held their hands again, and the sound shook the tiles of the palace.
What happened in the morning was spread throughout the palace in less than half an hour, but Meng Chanyue knew nothing about it.
At this time, she was squatting by a well with about a dozen palace slaves, washing clothes, and there was a pile of clothes piled high beside her.
The steward put his hands behind his back, humming a tune and walking around to supervise the work. When he saw a palace slave slacking off, he immediately glared at him sideways. When the palace attendant waiting nearby saw him, he took half a step forward and whipped him.
It was winter, and the well water was freezing cold. Meng Chanyue's hand turned red as soon as she put her hand into the water. As the third princess of Nanliang, she had never done such rough work since she was a child. The slender white hands rubbed the burlap clothes, and in an instant, several red marks appeared on the back of the hands.
When Manager Mao saw her like this, he suddenly felt pity for her. He walked over and got close to Meng Chanyue.
"Chanyue, it's a pity that you are a palace slave."
"With your appearance, as long as you are willing, there are many men who can ride for you."
After saying that, a pair of slender eyebrows stared straight at Meng Chanyue's snow-white and delicate neck.
Meng Chanyue felt her stomach churn when she was stared at by his greasy and lewd eyes. Her eyes turned cold, and she rubbed the clothes in the tub vigorously. The cold and biting well water overflowed and splashed the black boots of the manager.
Meeting Meng Chanyue's stern and cold eyes, Steward Ma couldn't help but take half a step back. Then he stood up angrily and said loudly: "Palace slave Chanyue is disrespectful to me. I'll double the quota. If you can't finish washing, you won't be allowed to eat."
After the words fell, there was another pile of clothes in front of Meng Chanyue, which was slightly taller than the previous one.
title_en: Chapter 7 Becoming a Palace Slave Chapter 8 The Third Princess of Nanliang
